text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Oka Sho. Rhein Kraft tells 
her fellow Umamusume classmates that she 
won't be aiming for the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her new goals were to conquer the Oka Sho 
and the NHK Mile Cup. Driven by her wish 
to become someone others could look up to, 
she chose a path all her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Daring Heart couldn't get Rhein 
Kraft's declaration out of her head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart's dream is the Triple Tiara. 
Yet, parting ways with Rhein Kraft leaves 
her heart wavering...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho had arrived. Rhein Kraft, 
having chosen her own path, was about to 
embark on a brand-new challenge.
